transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Could you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I guess I came in because my head just doesn't really stay on task anymore. Like... I'll be doing inventory at work, or trying to study for this supervisor certification, and I just keep reading the same line over and over. Or I'll go to the supply closet and forget what I even went in there for. So... yeah. Just having trouble with that.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. It's, um... I don't know. Most days there's just this... heavy, flat feeling. Kind of just follows me around. Doesn't really matter if I'm just pushing my cleaning cart down an empty hallway at work, or... sitting with my family, trying to act normal. It just... feels flat.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about things, even when there isn't a clear reason for it?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I worry that much. I don't really get worked up about things, so... no.
Have you noticed that activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends, feel less pleasurable or rewarding lately?
Um... I guess so. I don't really do much anymore. Just work and come home. It's just... hard to care about doing anything else.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy levels or feel unusually tired lately, even after resting?
I mean... I guess I'm tired. But I'm on my feet all day at work, so... it makes sense. I don't know if it's unusual. Just... tired.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

I mean... I don't know if I'd call it depressed. It's just... most days, there's this heavy, flat feeling. It kind of just follows me around. Even when I'm just pushing my cleaning cart down an empty hallway at work, or... sitting with my family and trying to act normal. It's just... always there, I guess.
Have you noticed that it’s harder to think clearly or concentrate lately, like your mind feels foggy or you can’t focus even when you want to?

Yeah... I guess that's actually why I'm here. My head just... it won't stay on task. Like, I'll be trying to do inventory at work, or... I've been trying to study for this supervisor certification. But I just end up reading the same sentence over and over. Or I'll walk into the supply closet and just... stand there, trying to remember what I needed. It's just... foggy, I guess.
How often do you feel this way — like your mind is foggy and you can’t focus, or everything feels flat and heavy? Is this something that happens every day, most days, or just occasionally?
I mean... I don't really know. I don't keep track. Just... a lot, I guess. Probably most days. I haven't really thought about exactly how often it is.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the foggy thinking and everything feeling flat and heavy?

A while, I guess. Um... maybe three years? Yeah, about three years. It started back when the contractor changed our schedules... put us on rotating evening and overnight shifts at the larger properties. Just... been like this since then.
Has the heavy, flat feeling in your mood come first, or did it start after you began having trouble focusing and getting things done at work and in your studies?

I'm not really sure which was first. Um... they kind of just go together. Most days I just feel like there's this heavy, flat feeling following me around. Like... even when I'm just pushing the cart down an empty hallway at work, or sitting with my family and trying to act normal. It's just there. So I don't really know what started it.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt down or hopeless every day for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
Um... I don't really know about two weeks straight like that. I don't think so. It doesn't really get worse or anything, it's just... kind of always the same. Just that flat feeling I mentioned.
Have there been times when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day, for most of the day, even if just for a few days in a row?
Um... no, not really. It's just... like I said, it's always just kind of the same flat feeling. It doesn't really dip down into feeling hopeless like that. Just... steady, I guess.
Have you had days where your mood feels low or flat most of the time, on most days, for at least 2 years?

Yeah... longer than two years, actually. Probably about three years now. Um... it started around the time the contractor switched us to rotating evening and overnight shifts at the larger properties. So... yeah, it's been going on since then.
